dedupe_keys.name: matrice des distances sur routes nationales et cr

description: Matrice des distances sur routes nationales et CR is a dataset listed in The Luxembourg Data Platform, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Administration du cadastre et de la topographie. Based on data from BD-L-TC 2013 and the list of locations, a distance matrix was calculated. It is a flat file that contains about 1'000'000 lines. Coverage: Administration du cadastre et de la topographie. The portal shows the English title as "Matrix of distances on national and CR roads" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Administration du cadastre et de la topographie. Its keywords include mobility, distances, mobilite, localites, routes-nationales, transport. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is cc-zero. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-la-plateforme-de-donnees-luxembourgeoise.
